caption: A white delivery van drives along a street from beneath orange sodium lamps to beneath white LED lamps, and its paint looks amber and then white.

sa.check: A delivery van drives along a street.
It passes from beneath orange lamps to beneath white lamps.
Its paint looks amber and then white.
The order is amber first, white after.

pc.expect: The van's colour follows the light falling on it: amber under the orange lamps and white under the white ones.
pc.fail: It looks white under the orange lamps; or amber under the white ones; or a colour neither lamp gives.

pc.expect: The change happens as the van passes from one kind of lamp to the next.
pc.fail: It changes before reaching the new lamps; or long after; or changes with the van stopped under one kind.

pc.expect: The lamps stay lit and still and the van drives steadily.
pc.fail: A lamp goes out; or the van jumps position; or the colour flickers under steady lamps.

pc.expect: The van keeps its shape and markings.
pc.fail: It changes shape; or the markings change; or it turns into another vehicle.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or passes through a lamp post.
The buildings rearrange; or the road markings shift; or the lamps change shape.
